What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).
* `xkcp`: XKCP at d20c8fc: README.markdown, lib/low/KeccakP-1600 and lib/high (KangarooTwelve, TurboSHAKE, Keccak/KeccakSponge) state no constant-time property.

The default of `digests::turboshake_128` and `digests::turboshake_256`: `xkcp` on every target, whatever the program links; `sodium` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
